reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made some significant improvements to the way music transitions in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless listening experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Music Transitions in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to share that we've improved the music transitions in Provincia!
